title: WatchIPTV 1.0.1
notes:
WatchIPTV 1.0.1 for phone, Android TV and Wear OS.

| file | what |
|---|---|
| `WatchIPTV-phone-v1.0.1-26634011.apk` | phone (Android 8.0+) |
| `WatchIPTV-tv-v1.0.1-26634011.apk` | Android TV (Android 8.0+) |
| `WatchIPTV-watch-v1.0.1-26634011.apk` | watch (Wear OS 3+) |

Install **all from this same release**. The phone and the watch only pair when both halves share one signing key, which these do. The TV pairs over the home Wi-Fi with a code on its screen; see the Devices screen on the phone.

Watch, over ADB: `adb connect <watch-ip>:5555 && adb -s <watch-ip>:5555 install -r WatchIPTV-watch-v1.0.1-26634011.apk`

TV, over ADB: `adb connect <tv-ip>:5555 && adb -s <tv-ip>:5555 install -r WatchIPTV-tv-v1.0.1-26634011.apk`

The files named without a version (`WatchIPTV-phone.apk`, `WatchIPTV-tv.apk`, `WatchIPTV-watch.apk`) are the same ones, for always-latest links.
